title: SeatingTable
description: One table of a wedding's seating plan (issue #46): a name and how many guests it seats. Stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, table_id).

table_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, when changed.
